name: recluse-studio
description: Search and read Recluse Studio's published articles, retrieve source passages, and follow related work with original attribution.

interface.longDescription: Search Recluse Studio’s published research and build reports on AI, knowledge management, music equipment, and creative work. Retrieve articles in numbered passages with original source links, author attribution, publication dates, and canonical URLs. Find recent posts and related articles through the publication’s curated topics. The connector provides public, read-only access and requires no login.
